BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: I want to get my concealed carry permit in Illinois. ASSISTANT:

To get a Concealed Carry Permit in Illinois, you must be at least 21 years old, complete a training course, pass a background check, and pay the required fee. You can find more information on the Illinois State Police website.
